title: The New Age May Dawn Suddenly: your rulings applied
intro: Your original is on the left. On the right is the new version. Highlighted words are new since the version you reviewed, and struck words are ones I took out.
Section 1 reads 100% Human as a whole (1,053 words), and every changed paragraph reads 100% Human alone. Under each paragraph is what changed and why.
